payload.title: Using Surrogate Series with Pyleoclim
payload.description: This notebook provides an overview of the SurrogateSeries class in the Pyleoclim library, focusing on generating and visualizing surrogate data to assess the significance of various analyses. It covers both parametric and non-parametric surrogate generation methods, including autoregressive models and phase scrambling. The notebook demonstrates how to fit surrogates to specific datasets like the Southern Oscillation Index and LR04, and discusses their use in significance testing.
